timing_boundaries.mech: one fresh canonical JIT evaluation, including finite admission, library calls, output creation and atomic publication; parsing/JIT compilation/input import/cache flush excluded
timing_boundaries.c_kernel: unmodified C kernel over reset buffers; initialization, allocation, copying, cache flush and printing excluded
timing_boundaries.c_fresh: fresh allocation/copy of C buffers plus unmodified C kernel; cache flush and printing excluded

validation_boundary: Each process validates its untimed warm-up result against the full C live-outs; all timed checked calls must succeed. Original/decoded numerical equivalence is also covered by the independent maintained regressions.
